description: List the newest ransomware leak-site claims (1-10), optionally filtered to one group such as akira or qilin. Use it to watch recent activity; use lookup_victim to search for a specific company. Only commercially reusable sources are used, so country and sector are often null. Every result is an unverified claim from a criminal leak site, not a confirmed breach. Read-only. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or an upstream failure returns an error and is not charged.

group.description: Ransomware group name, e.g. akira, qilin

name: recent_claims
